criteria.requirement: Implement bibtexparser.keywords.SplitKeywords and MergeKeywords as opt-in non-mutating BlockMiddleware classes. Split only top-level single-character delimiters, preserving nested braces and backslash-escaped delimiters, with explicit keep_empty behavior. Reject unbalanced braces, preserve keyword order/duplicates and support custom delimiters. Merge actual string lists back to reversible strings, protecting unbraced delimiter-containing items. Do not reuse author splitting or change default parse/write stacks.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
